MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Marine Operations and Seamanship 4.3 Marine Resource Utilisation 4.4 Blue Econom and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Safety of Humans and Equipment Undertaking Marine Activities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Marine Resource Utilisation 4.4 Blue Economy and Marine Entrepreneurship Page 12 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Marine Resource Utilisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
